agents_linked_evidence_check.name: agents_linked_evidence_check
agents_linked_evidence_check.value: "agents"."integration_status" <> 'linked' OR ("agents"."external_agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agents"."external_wallet" IS NOT NULL)

agents_active_versions_check.name: agents_active_versions_check
agents_active_versions_check.value: ("agents"."active_strategy_version" IS NULL OR "agents"."active_strategy_version" > 0) AND ("agents"."active_risk_policy_version" IS NULL OR "agents"."active_risk_policy_version" > 0) AND ("agents"."status" <> 'active' OR ("agents"."active_strategy_version" IS NOT NULL AND "agents"."active_risk_policy_version" IS NOT NULL))

execution_attempts_signature_state_check.name: execution_attempts_signature_state_check
execution_attempts_signature_state_check.value: "execution_attempts"."state" NOT IN ('submitted', 'confirmed', 'unknown_pending') OR "execution_attempts"."transaction_signature" IS NOT NULL

execution_attempts_confirmation_evidence.name: execution_attempts_confirmation_evidence_check
execution_attempts_confirmation_evidence.value: "execution_attempts"."state" <> 'confirmed' OR ("execution_attempts"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "execution_attempts"."slot" IS NOT NULL)
